codeContextWithViolation:
function printEvent(e) {
  switch (e.type) {
    case 'start':
      console.log(
        `\n👀 Watching ${e.slugs.length} skill(s) for changes...\n`,
      )
      break
    case 'skip':
      console.log(`   Skipping "${e.slug}" (${e.sourceType} source)`)
      break
    case 'watching':
      console.log(`   ✓ ${e.slug} → watching ${e.path}`)
      break
    case 'error':
      console.error(`   ✗ ${e.slug}: cannot watch (${e.error.message})`)
      break
    case 'syncing':
      console.log(
        `  [${e.startedAt.toLocaleTimeString()}] ${e.slug}: ${e.filename} changed, syncing...`,
      )
      break
    case 'synced':
      console.log(
        `  [${e.startedAt.toLocaleTimeString()}] ${e.slug}: ${e.ok ? 'synced successfully' : 'sync failed'}`,
      )
      break
  }
}
